excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: I am curious about the scenario in which an `AttesterSlashing` created before Electra has to be processed after the fork transition. My guess is that the SSZ encoding of the modified definition of `AttesterSlashing` is backwards compatible with its previous version and it should work. Obviously, HTR isn't backwards compatible but it should not matter in this case, should it? 🤔
